result.title: SPiXSeg: Rethinking MLLM-based Image Segmentation as Superpixel Classification
result.summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are widely used for image segmentation. However, existing methods either use a decoder or use patch-based approach which trades boundary precision against the number of decisions as coarse grid cells mix foreground and background pixels, while finer grids require many more predictions, and autoregressive mask generation adds sequential decoding overhead. We propose SPiXSeg, which shifts the output from per-patch to per-superpixel label assignment, using superpixel tokens formed by aggregating patch-level visual features. An off-the-shelf model partitions each image into task-agnostic superpixels, so the partition is computed once and reused across tasks. A Spix-to-Mask (S2M) module scores each superpixel token in a single MLLM forward pass by directly comparing the MLLM's hidden representations, without autoregressive generation or a separate scoring network, and the selected superpixels are mapped directly to pixels without refinement. Without any trainable decoder head or post-hoc refinement, SPiXSeg achieves an average cIoU of 80.5 with LLaVA-1.5-7B and 81.9 with InternVL2.5-8B on RefCOCO, RefCOCO+ and RefCOCOg and, when trained only on COCO-Stuff, extends to open-vocabulary semantic segmentation with mIoU of 29.0, 59.5 and 95.4 on ADE20K, PASCAL Context and PASCAL VOC, outperforming several SoTA MLLM baselines. Our results suggest that a fixed, query-agnostic superpixel partition is enough for accurate language-guided segmentation.

AI.brief_summary: SPiXSeg 把基于 MLLM 的图像分割改造为 superpixel 级标签分配：用现成分割模型一次性生成任务无关的 superpixel，将 patch 特征聚合为 superpixel token，再由 S2M 模块在单次前向中通过比较 MLLM 隐表示打分，无需解码器或自回归生成。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「单次前向直接比较隐表示来判定视觉 token」的做法，可能为 LVR 中基于 latent 相似度的视觉证据筛选与并行（非自回归）状态输出提供核查线索，但论文本身面向分割精度，未研究推理状态或 THINK/LOOK/STOP 机制。
